entries.tactical_failure_mode_quoted: Papers attempting this tactic fail most often when the constructed instrument isolates the confound only inside an artificial regime and never demonstrates that the isolated signal transfers to real deployment conditions — the synthetic-to-real gap is asserted rather than shown. A second recurring shape is circularity: the diagnostic is validated against the same definition, assumption, or system population it was built to interrogate, so it cannot independently confirm what it claims.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: A diagnostic that only re-confirms a shortcut already known in advance, surfacing no previously unmeasurable failure, is read as confirmatory rather than as a contribution.
reject_lessons_evaluated.reasoning: The proposed switch-versus-nonswitch performance split is not already reported by the supplied corpus, so the intended finding is not merely a restatement of a retrieved result.

entries.tactical_pattern_quoted: The shared move is to construct a controlled set of evaluation instances in which exactly one named confound is either structurally blocked or independently varied, then report the divergence between apparent and de-confounded performance as the primary result rather than an aggregate leaderboard score. The load-bearing artifact is always the controlled instance set paired with an oracle independent of the system under test.

recipe_application_check.reasoning: The only entry attempts formal generation and an independent simulator oracle, but the executed blockers show that the defining C02 operation—holding non-target difficulty axes fixed while producing verifiable alternative strategies—is absent from the executable mechanism.

paper_pointed_threat.subsumption_argument: SSP is the closest retrieved competitor because its abstract describes an event-matched VLA evaluation whose validated specification preserves topology, roles, relative motion, passing order, constraints, and event phases across synthetic, simulated, and physical realizations. It does not, on the available abstract, subsume GISS's same-goal geometry intervention or certify that a nominal manipulation strategy becomes infeasible, but it weakens any broad claim that event-matched controlled VLA evaluation itself is new; all differentiation is abstract-level because full text is unavailable.
paper_pointed_threat.parametric_family_concern: Metamorphic testing and metamorphic relations for simulator-based systems; scoop-check vocabulary: 'metamorphic robot policy testing' and 'counterfactual simulation test generation'.

falsification_structure_check.reasoning: Permuting q and expecting TCSG to collapse is tautological because TCSG is defined as a success contrast conditioned on q; the control destroys the grouping variable from which the metric is analytically computed. A non-tautological downstream control would have to intervene on strategy information, such as the already-mentioned label-permuted sigma input, and predict native q=1 success returns to the ordinary-input baseline.

blocking_findings_disposition.finding_ref: Step 4 has no actual producer for the alternative executable signatures and path-component membership
blocking_findings_disposition.basis: The quoted steps produce only the source expert signature sigma_0 and a symbolic grammar; the executed dry-run had to stipulate an external feasibility table, so adding executable controllers or planner synthesis plus a coverage certificate would change the compiler's load-bearing machinery rather than clarify a field.

blocking_findings_disposition.finding_ref: Nearest normalized geometry distance does not make q=0 and q=1 observations equally difficult
blocking_findings_disposition.basis: The two executed causal worlds have identical observed q, geometry distance, and success means but different causes, proving TCSG is not a topology-causal estimand; relabeling it descriptive would relinquish the anchor causal-identifiability claim, while identification would require redesigned interventions or a defensible difficulty model.

verdict_rationale: The recipe_application_check entry is bypassed because the candidate cannot execute C02's defining controlled-instance construction: the alternative strategy producer is missing and switch status remains confounded with difficulty. Both blocking_findings_disposition entries are upheld and each requires redesign of what the mechanism or claim is, while falsification_structure_check is independently deficient because q-permutation makes its TCSG control tautological; the C02 contested-definition and engineering-without-isolation reject lessons remain borderline rather than independently triggering the hard floor.
